generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential unique integers starting at a compact base (e.g. 1001); never NULL; no duplicates; generated count must equal table_sizes_per_instance exactly (no silent dedup drops).
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sample from parent key pool; allow NULL where nullable; do NOT plant out-of-pool non-NULL values in columns carrying a FOREIGN KEY constraint (SQLite FK semantics allow NULL child FKs only).
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer within the column's range rule; include listed boundary literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Random strings of length 1-12 from a small pool; allow near-duplicates and case variants where listed.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_code: Random 3-letter uppercase codes from a small pool; include listed literals and near-variants.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_date: Random dates in %m/%d/%Y format within a plausible range; include duplicates.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_small: Uniform choice among the listed enum values.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For nullable columns, plant NULL in the listed share of rows; never replace a planted NULL; re-verify the share after ALL planting passes (including unmatched-join) and re-plant if below the minimum; report shares as fractions in [0,1] consistently.
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_duplicates: Ensure the listed duplicate share on DISTINCT-targeted columns by reusing values from a small pool, applied only to non-boundary rows so planted boundary values survive; boundary rows count toward the duplicate share when they are themselves duplicates; re-verify the share after ALL planting passes and re-plant if below the minimum.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_values: For each listed literal, include the literal, one step below and one step above (numeric step 1, string near-variants); boundary rows are reserved and never overwritten by duplicate-share enforcement; the boundary set is disjoint from the domain set unless explicitly stated.
generic_sampling_rules.tie_ranks: For ORDER/COUNT targets, arrange group counts so that ties occur at the listed ranks; tie structure is built after duplicate enforcement and verified post-generation.
generic_sampling_rules.unmatched_join: Plant parent rows with no child and child rows with NULL FK (only where the FK column is nullable). Never plant out-of-pool non-NULL FK values in columns carrying a FOREIGN KEY constraint. Planting happens exactly once, in the per-table construction path before duplicate enforcement and NULL planting; report counts from that single pass.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: Observed distinct majors; boundary values -1,0,1,599,601 are intentional comparison_boundary exceptions outside the observed domain; 600 is a domain value and also the anchor for the one-step boundary 599/601.
All sample dates parse as %m/%d/%Y; year range 2010-2016 is a program choice consistent with the sample dates.

supporting_evidence: Student.Sex values F, M from sample rows.
Student.Major distinct values from sample rows.
Voting_record.Election_Cycle values Spring, Fall from sample rows.
uncertainty: Exact NULL share for nullable Voting_record vote columns is estimated from statistics (5-30%).
Unmatched join rows and parent rows without children are planted deterministically per atomic-operation targets; exact counts not fixed.
Student.Advisor and city_code boundary literals are taken from atomic-operation summary, not observed data; low confidence.

Voting_record.StuID is a nullable FK; it is included in null_targets with a 5-30% NULL share and also participates in unmatched_join planting; NULL planting happens in the per-table construction path before duplicate enforcement.

Boundary planting takes precedence over duplicate-share enforcement; duplicate enforcement applies only to non-boundary rows, except that domain values overlapping the boundary anchor (Student.Major 600) are eligible.
Student.Advisor is stored as INTEGER; string-literal comparisons such as = '2192' rely on SQLite type affinity and are not guaranteed to match.
Table sizes are fixed at the compact database sizes (Student 34, Voting_record 10); the program must not vary them; generated row count must equal these values exactly (no silent dedup drops).
Registration_Date year range 2010-2016 is a program choice, not a database rule.
Out-of-pool non-NULL FK values are NOT planted in any column carrying a FOREIGN KEY constraint; only NULL child FKs and parent rows without children are planted, so fk_violations must be 0.
Unmatched-join planting runs exactly once, before NULL/duplicate enforcement; NULL and duplicate shares are re-verified after all planting passes and reported as fractions in [0,1].
